fine_lines.title: do vs make (chores)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: مع أعمال المنزل نستخدم غالبًا do: do the laundry، do the dishes. ومع الطعام make: make dinner.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use "do" with many chores (do the laundry). Use "make" for food (make dinner).

fine_lines.title: turn on vs turn off
fine_lines.explanation_ar: turn on = تشغّل. turn off = تطفئ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Turn on" = start a machine. "Turn off" = stop it.

grammar.title: Present simple for routines (he/she + -s)
grammar.explanation_ar: للروتين نستخدم المضارع البسيط، ومع he/she نضيف s أو es: she sweeps, he washes, she irons.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present simple for routines; add -s/-es with he/she.

grammar.title: Ordering: I'd like to start with ... / I'll have ...
grammar.explanation_ar: في المطعم: I'd like to start with + المقبلات، I'll have + الطبق، I prefer it + صفة.
grammar.explanation_en: At a restaurant: "I'd like to start with ...", "I'll have ...", "I prefer it ...".
examples: I'd like to start with a salad.
